components.name: pygame-ce
components.note: Checked in pygame-ce's source at tag 2.5.8: the files that carry a header say 'GNU Library General Public License ... either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version' (Pete Shinners, 2000-2001); pyproject.toml says 'LGPL v2.1' and docs/LGPL.txt is the LGPL 2.1 text, which 'or later' includes. Its bundled SDL_gfx primitives are LGPL too (A. Schiffler). The Windows DLLs it ships are listed under Native libraries.

components.name: AvQest (display font)
components.version: GemFonts AvQest 1.3 from 1001fonts.com avqest.zip, AvQest.ttf sha256 5929a5fd6c16df17069ed7cf57b6ff61bbe3c959d9ef59b30120a3845d98fee6 (unmodified)
components.shipped: builds Karl makes; not in the public source copy
components.note: Karl's decision on 2026-10-02: the author (GemFonts) lists AvQest as Freeware for personal and commercial use on FontSpace (fontspace.com/gemfonts/avqest), which Karl takes as permission to ship it in the app. The 1001fonts FFC text that came in the zip is kept below for reference. The embedding flag (OS/2 fsType 1) is a deprecated legacy value, not a restriction. tools/export_public.py still leaves the font out of the public source copy (the game falls back to Cinzel Decorative there).

components.name: Cinzel Decorative (display font, public source)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2012 Natanael Gama (info@ndiscovered.com), with Reserved Font Name 'Cinzel'
components.used_for: Headings and buttons when AvQest is not there, e.g. in the public source copy (assets/fonts/CinzelDecorative-Bold.ttf)
components.note: Replaced the unlicensed 'Diablo Heavy' display.ttf on 2026-10-01; since AvQest was chosen the same day it is the open-source fallback. Shipped unmodified, so the Reserved Font Name is not an issue.

components.name: Mana (mana symbol font)
components.copyright: Mana font by Andrew Gioia (https://mana.andrewgioia.com); the font's own name table says 'SIL OFL 1.1'
components.used_for: Mana, tap/untap, energy and other symbols in costs, rules text, the mana pool and the payment window (assets/fonts/mana.ttf)
components.note: The symbols drawn by the font are Wizards of the Coast's, used under the Fan Content Policy like the card pictures. mplantin/beleren from the same package are commercial fonts and are NOT shipped.

components.name: Mana CSS codepoint table
components.version: mana-font 1.18.0 css/mana.css (the glyph codepoints copied into gfx.MANA_GLYPHS)
components.used_for: Which character of the Mana font is which symbol (gfx.MANA_GLYPHS)
components.note: package.json and README say the CSS/LESS/Sass files are MIT. The npm package has no LICENSE file of its own, so the copyright line is the author as package.json names him.

components.name: Table backgrounds, splash, title and window icon (Manticore concept art, AI-generated)
components.copyright: Created with Grok (xAI) for the Manticore project
components.used_for: The pictures behind the table and deck screen (assets/backgrounds/), the studio splash, the title screen and the window icon (assets/splash/)
components.note: All the concept art was made with Grok (Karl, 2026-10-01). Still to check before a release: Grok/xAI's terms for using and redistributing generated images (UNVERIFIED). AI-generated images may carry no copyright of their own in many places; the credits say how they were made and claim nothing more.
components.attribution: xAI's Brand Guidelines (x.ai/legal/brand-guidelines, 14 Feb 2025) ask for the words "Created with Grok" wherever Grok-generated material is distributed; they are in the "Game art" credit in Cog > Licenses and credits and in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

components.name: Sound effects, ambience and music (CC0 recordings, Round AU1)

com.googlecode.soundlibs.name: JLayer / MP3SPI / Tritonus (soundlibs)
com.googlecode.soundlibs.note: Checked in the sources jars: jlayer 1.0.1.4 (47 of 47 files), mp3spi 1.9.5.4 (17 of 17) and tritonus-share 0.3.7.4 (58 of 60) say 'GNU Library General Public License ... version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version'. Tritonus' FloatInputStream.java and FloatSampleInput.java are BSD-2-Clause (Florian Bomers, 2006); their notice is attached. The POM's 'LGPL 2.1' was not the whole story.

javax.servlet.name: Java Servlet API
javax.servlet.license: (CDDL-1.1 OR GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0) AND Apache-2.0
javax.servlet.note: Checked in javax.servlet-api-3.1.0-sources: all 72 files are 'GPL Version 2 only or CDDL' with the Classpath exception (glassfish CDDL+GPL_1_1); 40 of them are also 'Copyright 2004 The Apache Software Foundation' under Apache-2.0. We take the CDDL/GPL part under GPL-2.0 with the Classpath exception. The jar's own META-INF/LICENSE.txt (CDDL 1.0 + GPL 2 + Classpath exception) is attached.

javazoom.name: JLayer (javazoom)

org.jupnp.name: jUPnP
org.jupnp.note: CDDL-1.0 is listed by the FSF as incompatible with the GNU GPL. Forge uses jUPnP for its own network hosting. Since Round MP1 (2026-10-02) Manticore's bridge uses it too: Upnp.java asks the router to open the online-play port when hosting (the "Try to open my router port automatically" box). Karl's decision (OPEN_QUESTIONS A11, 2026-09-24, kept for MP1 in SONNET_SPEC_MP1): ship Forge's jar as is and list jUPnP honestly here rather than build a stand-in. UNVERIFIED (not legal advice): whether Manticore's own GPL code should carry a GPLv3 section 7 additional permission for linking with jUPnP; Karl, as the copyright holder of that code, can add one. Whether Forge's own bundle is compliant is Forge's packaging question, not ours - we redistribute forge.jar unchanged.

credits.title: Game art

credits.title: MPC Autofill pictures (optional)
credits.text: The Card art picker's MPC Autofill tab shows community-made card renders indexed by MPC Autofill (mpcfill.com; its software is free under the GNU GPL v3). Nothing is fetched until you open that tab, and only the picture you pick is downloaded, to this computer's card cache; none are included with the program. Each picture belongs to the person who made it. MPC Autofill and its contributors are not affiliated with this program.
